options.text: They share material properties of metals.
Each metals group may hold only one object.
Grouping by shiny colour is the only correct grouping for these objects.
The metals group is correct only when exactly three objects are always present.

stem:
Vikram puts a steel spoon, a copper coin, and an aluminium plate in one group. He says they belong together as metals.

What common property is he using for this classification?

teacher.key_rationale: Classification here uses the shared material properties of metals. A metals group can hold several objects; shiny colour alone is not the only basis; the common property does not require exactly three objects.
